newsitem.title: JAPAN: Key 182nd 10-yr JGB yield rises 10 bps to 2.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Key 182nd 10-yr JGB yield rises 10 bps to 2.4 pct.

text.p: The yield of the key 182nd 10-year Japanese government bond (JGB) rose 10 basis points to 2.4 percent in Tokyo on Tuesday morning.
The yield rose sharply on hedge selling in cash JGBs amid steep declines in JGB futures this morning.
The key June 10-year JGB futures contract fell as low as 124.32 by midday, a fall of more than one full point from Friday's finish at 125.50.
The market was closed on Monday for a holiday.
Traders said the JGB market was sold on increasing fears of higher interest rates due to stronger-than-expected rises in Tokyo stocks.
